Cargo.toml.content_utf8:
[package]
name = "mech"
version = "0.3.6"
authors = ["Corey Montella <corey@mech-lang.org>"]
description = "Mech is a programming language for building reactive systems like robots, games, and animations."
documentation = "https://docs.mech-lang.org"
homepage = "https://mech-lang.org"
repository = "https://github.com/mech-lang/mech"
keywords = ["mech", "language", "programming", "dataflow", "runtime"]
categories = ["science::robotics", "science", "game-engines", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.92"

[[bin]]
name = "mech"
path = "src/bin/mech.rs"
required-features = ["cli_core"]

[[example]]
name = "embedded_ekf"
path = "examples/embedded_ekf/main.rs"
required-features = ["kernel-aot"]

[[example]]
name = "mech_backend_pairs"
path = "benchmarks/iros-2026/mech_backend_pairs.rs"
required-features = ["kernel-benchmarks"]

[[test]]
name = "kernel_embedding"
path = "tests/kernel_embedding.rs"
required-features = ["kernel-aot"]

[profile.release]
debug = false

[profile.test]
# The exhaustive native-factory matrix otherwise produces multi-gigabyte
# test executables that macOS cannot map alongside the shared dyld cache.
debug = false
strip = "symbols"

# Benchmark the optimized numerical executors without optimizing the large
# source compiler/catalog, which runs before the measurement window.
[profile.kernel-bench]
inherits = "dev"
debug = false
incremental = false
strip = "symbols"

[profile.kernel-bench.package.mech]
opt-level = 3

[profile.kernel-bench.package.mech-gpu]
opt-level = 3

[profile.kernel-bench.package.mech-compute]
opt-level = 3

[profile.kernel-bench.package.wide]
opt-level = 3

[features]
kernel = ["dep:mech-gpu", "mech-gpu/embedding"]
kernel-aot = ["kernel", "mech-gpu/aot"]
kernel-benchmarks = ["kernel-aot", "mech-runtime", "mech-gpu/metal-native", "mech-gpu/benchmark-probes"]
no_std = ["mech-core/no_std", "mech-engine/no_std", "mech-stdlib/no_std", "mech-syntax/no_std"]

standard_runtime = [
      "mech-engine/runtime",
      "mech-stdlib/standard_runtime",
      "math_add_assign", "math_sub_assign",
      "mech-runtime?/resident-routing",
      ]
standard_source = [
      "standard_runtime",
      "mech-engine/source",
      "mech-syntax/program",
      "mech-stdlib/standard_source",
      ]
standard_compiler = [
      "standard_source",
      "mech-engine/compiler",
      "mech-stdlib/standard_compiler",
      "mech-runtime?/compiler",
      "mech-runtime?/resident-routing-source",
      ]

full_runtime = [
      "mech-engine/runtime",
      "mech-stdlib/full_runtime",
      "mech-runtime?/resident-routing",
      ]
full_source = [
      "full_runtime",
      "mech-engine/source",
      "mech-syntax/program",
      "mech-stdlib/full_source",
      ]
full_compiler = [
      "full_source",
      "mech-engine/compiler",
      "mech-stdlib/full_compiler",
      "mech-runtime?/compiler",
      "mech-runtime?/resident-routing-source",
      ]

default = ["distribution-standard"]

distribution-standard = [
      "standard_compiler", "standard-hosts", "standard-cli", "standard-language",
      ]
distribution-full = [
      "full_compiler", "full-hosts", "full-cli", "full-language",
      ]
standard-language = [
      "pretty_print", "serde", "compiler", "program", "mika",
      "bool", "string", "f64",
      "set", "map", "table", "tuple", "record", "atom", "enum",
      "row_vectord", "vectord", "matrixd",
      "statements_default", "subscript_default", "state_machines",
      "async", "trace",
      ]
full-language = [
      "baselib", "pretty_print", "serde", "compiler", "program", "mika",
      "u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "u128", 
      "i8", "i16", "i32", "i64", "i128", 
      "f32", "f64", "c64", "r64",
      "statements_default", "subscript_default", "state_machines",
      "async", "trace",
      "mech-core/full", "mech-syntax/full",
      ]
standard-cli = ["cli-product"]
full-cli = ["cli-product"]
standard-hosts = [
      "cli_host",
      "time_host_native", "timer_host_native", "console_host_native", "scene_host_native",
      "time_host_browser", "timer_host_browser", "console_host_browser", "scene_host_browser",
      "web_host",
      "mech-build?/standard-hosts",
      ]
full-hosts = [
      "standard-hosts",
      "dep:mech-robot-arm", "mech-robot-arm/provider",
      "mech-build?/full-hosts",
      ]
compute_backends_native = [
      "dep:mech-compute", "dep:mech-gpu", "mech-gpu/native", "mech-gpu/jit", "mech-gpu/aot",
      "mech-runtime/compute",
      "mech-runtime/f32", "mech-runtime/f64", "mech-runtime/string", "mech-runtime/matrixd",
      "f32", "row_vectord", "matrixd", "kind_annotation", "convert", "matrix_horzcat", "range_inclusive",
      "math_add", "math_sub", "math_mul", "math_div", "math_mod", "math_sin", "math_cos",
      "math_ceil", "math_floor",
      "mech-stdlib/native-plan",
      ]
base = ["baselib", "pretty_print", "serde", "compiler", "program", "mika",
      "statements_default", "subscript_default", "state_machines",
      "cli", "async", "trace",
      "mech-core/base", "mech-engine/base", "mech-syntax/base",
      ]
cli_core = []
cli-product = ["cli_core", "build", "formatter", "serve", "bundle_web", "run"]
cli = ["cli-product"]
formatter_core = ["serde", "mech-syntax/formatter", "mech-syntax/mika", "mech-core/mika", "mech-syntax/variable_define", "mech-core/variable_define"]
build = [
      "cli_core", "compiler",
      "dep:mech-build",
      "mech-stdlib/native-plan",
      "mech-runtime", "mech-runtime/compiler", "mech-runtime/native-link", "mech-runtime/serde",
      ]
# `mech run` is a complete source-to-resident product surface: it compiles the
# standard language, admits the resulting resident program, and installs the
# terminal provider used by retained CLI resources.  Keep that closure on the
# product feature instead of relying on distribution-default feature leakage.
run = [
      "cli_core", "project", "cli_host",
      "mech-engine/runtime", "mech-engine/source", "mech-engine/compiler",
      "mech-syntax/program",
      "mech-stdlib/standard_compiler",
      "mech-stdlib/math_add_assign", "mech-stdlib/math_sub_assign",
      "mech-runtime/compiler", "mech-runtime/resident-routing-source",
      ]
project = ["mech-runtime", "mech-runtime/source"]
cli_host = ["mech-runtime", "dep:mech-terminal", "mech-terminal/provider"]
web_host = ["mech-runtime", "mech-browser", "mech-browser/serde", "mech-browser/provider", "dep:mech-time", "dep:mech-timer", "dep:mech-console", "dep:mech-scene"]
bundle_web_core = ["project", "web_host", "formatter_core", "serde", "mech-runtime"]
bundle_web = ["cli_core", "bundle_web_core"]
# `mech serve` owns the same retained source-to-resident compilation boundary as
# `mech run`, plus browser hosts and workspace watching.  Keep the compiler and
# standard source catalog on this product feature so reduced browser/Windows
# builds cannot inherit them accidentally from a distribution default.
serve = [
      "cli_core", "project", "web_host", "formatter_core",
      "mech-engine/runtime", "mech-engine/source", "mech-engine/compiler",
      "mech-syntax/program",
      "mech-stdlib/standard_compiler",
      "mech-stdlib/math_add_assign", "mech-stdlib/math_sub_assign",
      "mech-runtime/compiler", "mech-runtime/resident-routing-source",
      "mech-runtime/watcher", "ignore",
      ]
host_delegation = ["serde", "mech-runtime", "mech-runtime/host_delegation", "mech-browser", "mech-browser/delegation"]
host_delegation_signing = ["host_delegation", "mech-runtime/host_delegation_signing", "mech-browser/delegation_signing"]
# Formatting resolves source/document inputs through the retained filesystem
# authority, but it does not compile or execute them. Keep that runtime-kernel
# closure explicit without pulling in the semantic compiler.
formatter = [
      "cli_core", "formatter_core",
      "mech-runtime", "mech-runtime/source", "mech-runtime/serde",
      ]
async = []
trace = ["mech-engine/trace"]
dynamic-modules = ["mech-engine/dynamic-modules"]
time_host_native = ["dep:mech-time", "mech-time/native"]
time_host_browser = ["dep:mech-time", "mech-time/browser"]
console_host_native = ["dep:mech-console", "mech-console/native"]
console_host_browser = ["dep:mech-console", "mech-console/browser"]
timer_host_native = ["dep:mech-timer", "mech-timer/native"]
timer_host_browser = ["dep:mech-timer", "mech-timer/browser"]
scene_host_native = ["dep:mech-scene", "mech-scene/native"]
scene_host_browser = ["dep:mech-scene", "mech-scene/browser"]

statements_default = ["variable_assign","variable_define","invariant_define","kind_define"]
subscript_default = ["subscript_slice", "subscript_range", "logical_indexing", "swizzle", "subscript_formula", "dot_indexing"]

stdlib = ["bool", "string", 
      "u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "u128", 
      "i8", "i16", "i32", "i64", "i128", 
      "f32", "f64", "c64", "r64", 
      "set", "map", "table", "tuple", "record", "atom", "enum",

+> math

EKF step @compute
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- One filter. The Rust host supplies the outer array of bearing measurements.
dt := 0.1<f32>
linear-velocity := 1f32
angular-velocity := 0.015<f32>
bearing := -0.55<f32>
measurement-noise := 0.25<f32>
finite-limit := 3.402823466e38<f32>
covariance-symmetry-tolerance := 0.0001<f32>
landmark := [140f32; 12f32]

process-noise := [0.01<f32> 0f32
                  0f32      0.0025<f32>]
identity := [1f32 0f32 0f32
             0f32 1f32 0f32
             0f32 0f32 1f32]
position-projection := [1f32 0f32 0f32
                        0f32 1f32 0f32]
basis-x := [1f32; 0f32; 0f32]
basis-y := [0f32; 1f32; 0f32]
basis-theta := [0f32; 0f32; 1f32]

~state := [55f32; 25f32; 0.4<f32>]
~covariance := [100f32 0f32   0f32
                0f32   100f32 0f32
                0f32   0f32   0.15<f32>]

theta := state · basis-theta
sin-theta := math/sin(theta)
cos-theta := math/cos(theta)
distance := linear-velocity * dt

predicted-state := state + [distance * cos-theta
                            distance * sin-theta
                            angular-velocity * dt]

motion-jacobian := [1f32 0f32 (0f32 - distance * sin-theta)
                    0f32 1f32 distance * cos-theta
                    0f32 0f32 1f32]

control-jacobian := [cos-theta * dt 0f32
                     sin-theta * dt 0f32
                     0f32            dt]

predicted-covariance := motion-jacobian ** covariance ** motion-jacobian' + control-jacobian ** process-noise ** control-jacobian'

delta := landmark - position-projection ** predicted-state
delta-x := delta · [1f32; 0f32]
delta-y := delta · [0f32; 1f32]
squared-range := delta · delta

predicted-bearing := math/atan2(delta-y, delta-x) - (predicted-state · basis-theta)
raw-innovation := bearing - predicted-bearing
innovation := math/atan2(math/sin(raw-innovation), math/cos(raw-innovation))

observation-jacobian := [delta-y / squared-range, (0f32 - delta-x) / squared-range, -1f32]
innovation-variance := observation-jacobian ** predicted-covariance · observation-jacobian + measurement-noise
gain := predicted-covariance ** observation-jacobian' / innovation-variance

corrected-state := predicted-state + gain * innovation
correction := identity - gain ** observation-jacobian
corrected-covariance := correction ** predicted-covariance ** correction' + (gain ** gain') * measurement-noise

-- Validate each candidate before replacing the published state.
candidate-x := corrected-state · basis-x
candidate-y := corrected-state · basis-y
candidate-theta := corrected-state · basis-theta

p00 := corrected-covariance[1,1]
p10 := corrected-covariance[2,1]
p20 := corrected-covariance[3,1]
p01 := corrected-covariance[1,2]
p11 := corrected-covariance[2,2]
p21 := corrected-covariance[3,2]
p02 := corrected-covariance[1,3]
p12 := corrected-covariance[2,3]
p22 := corrected-covariance[3,3]

finite-state := math/abs(candidate-x) <= finite-limit && math/abs(candidate-y) <= finite-limit && math/abs(candidate-theta) <= finite-limit
finite-covariance := math/abs(p00) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p10) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p20) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p01) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p11) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p21) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p02) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p12) <= finite-limit && math/abs(p22) <= finite-limit

finite-candidate! := finite-state && finite-covariance
positive-covariance! := p00 > 0f32 && p11 > 0f32 && p22 > 0f32
symmetric-covariance! := math/abs(p01 - p10) <= covariance-symmetry-tolerance && math/abs(p02 - p20) <= covariance-symmetry-tolerance && math/abs(p12 - p21) <= covariance-symmetry-tolerance

state = corrected-state
covariance = corrected-covariance
(state, covariance)
